assertions.evidence: In routeLead, before any fetch, it returns enterprise when headcount > 1000 or regions.length >= 3: `if (lead.headcount > 1000) return ...; if (lead.regions.length >= 3) return ...;`

The request uses the Decisions endpoint, but the model field is `model: JEV_MODEL` while the defined constant is `const JE V_MODEL = "typesafe/jev-1.13"`, so the pinned version ID is not clearly the one actually passed.
The request state only includes the free text: `state: { what_are_you_looking_for: lead.whatAreYouLookingFor }`, with no headcount or regions.
